spans.s: (With names of other animals) the male animal, as अजर्षभः a goat.
The best or most excellent (as the last member of a comp.); as पुरुषर्षभः, भरतर्षभः &c.
The second of the seven notes of the gamut; (said to be uttered by cows; गावस्त्वृषभभाषिणः); श्रुतिसमधिकमुच्चैः पञ्चमं पीडयन्तः सततमृषभहीनं भिन्नकीकृत्य षड्जम् Śi.11.1; ऋषभो$त्र गीयत इति Āryā
A dried plant, one of the 8 principal medicaments. (Mar. बैलघाटी, काकडशिंगी)
An incarnation of Viṣṇu; नाभेरसावृषभ आस सुदेविसूनुः
A sacrifice (to be performed by kings).-भाः m. The inhabitants of क्रौञ्चद्वीप;
भी A woman with masculine features (as a beard &c.).
The plant Carpopogon Pruriens (शूकशिंबी); also another plant (शिराला) (Mar. कुयली) -Comp. -कूटः N. of a mountain. -दीपः, पम् N. of a country. -ध्वजः N. of Śiva.
ऋषभकः [ṛṣabhakḥ], 1 N. of a medicinal plant.
ऋषभतरः [ṛṣabhatarḥ], A small or young bull.
